tweets.title: @HaoruXue It's not really a "rivalry" between VLA vs. WAM (vs. from-scratch) - when you have enough data, the thing that matters the most is how efficiently you
tweets.body: @HaoruXue It's not really a "rivalry" between VLA vs. WAM (vs. from-scratch) - when you have enough data, the thing that matters the most is how efficiently you learn from it, not what your model used to be before it was a policy. Most likely the best recipe will use parts of both.

tweets.title: Once you have an architecture that is able to soak up lots of data, the two things that determine downstream capabilities are (1) the data, and (2) your scaling
tweets.body: Once you have an architecture that is able to soak up lots of data, the two things that determine downstream capabilities are (1) the data, and (2) your scaling constant. Lots of the tricks that would make for good academic papers just stop mattering as much at large data scales.
